title: Plant funding monitor
description_html: Research funding calls relevant to plant genomics at IPK Gatersleben, collected daily from funders' websites and the EU Funding & Tenders portal. Every entry is extracted by a language model: check deadlines and eligibility against the original call before you apply.

funding.description: Updated every morning by the daily GitHub job. Start with the calls_search view.

calls_search.title: Funding calls
calls_search.description_html: One row per call, rejected calls left out. The search box looks in titles, summaries and funder names. Machine-extracted: check every entry against the original call (the link in the last column).

columns.title_en: Title in English (the original title if it is in English)
columns.title: Title as the funder writes it
columns.funder: Funding organisation, or the agency that runs the call for it
columns.next_deadline: Earliest deadline that hasn't passed; for yearly calls, the next occurrence. Empty for always-open calls and calls without a known deadline
columns.days_left: Days from today until the next deadline
columns.status: forthcoming, open, extended (a deadline moved later), closed or withdrawn
columns.ipk_eligible: Can IPK (a German non-university research institute) apply? yes, no or unclear
columns.relevance_score: Fit to plant genomics, 1 to 5: 5 plant genetics, genomics or breeding; 4 other plant science; 3 agronomy, the plant bioeconomy or any life science; 2 any discipline; 1 marginal
columns.summary_en: Short summary in English, written by the model
columns.original_url: The call's page or announcement: the source to check before applying

calls.description: Every field the pipeline extracts, including deadlines by stage, eligibility details and the evidence quotes. Includes rejected calls (review_status).

sources.description: The funder pages the pipeline watches.
